If one of your rental items arrived damaged, don’t worry, here’s what to do:

Document it immediately: On the day it arrives, record a clear video and take time‑stamped photos showing the full item and the damage.
Report within 24 hours: In the app, report an issue within the 24‑hour delivery inspection window and message the lender right away.
Don’t use the item: If it’s in poor/unusable condition, let the lender know and return it within 24 hours.
Request a refund: Submit a refund request to the lender so you can agree on a resolution.
Need more help? If the lender doesn’t respond to your refund request within 72 hours, email our Customer Support team at help@byrotation.com with your rental details and photos so we can step in and help.

Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a normal return.

Normal return: You just return the item on time, in the same condition, following the agreed method (in person or tracked postage).
Damaged item: You must immediately document with photos/videos, notify the other party within 24 hours, use the in‑app “Report an Issue”/dispute route, and it can lead to repair or reimbursement decisions.

If the lender doesn’t respond to a damaged‑on‑arrival refund request within 72 hours, or if a damage dispute can’t be resolved within 7 days, you should email our support team so we can step in and mediate based on the evidence you provide.
